paragraphs: Chapter 665
Episode 169: To the enemy's sanctuary (3)
"As you heard, Sir Ronil. I said Hister must be recovered at Zipel's sanctuary."
As Jin responded casually, Ronil's eyebrows narrowed. They hadn't seen him express his emotions so much at the last meeting. Kadun and Octavia were taken aback.
They hadn't expected to hear such shocking news at this moment when they had come to scold the temporary allies.
"Sir Jin, there are many ears listening right now. Did you think this was something that could be brought up in this setting?"
"I didn't realize it was such a big secret. I was told casually by the leader of Kinzelo."
Ronil glared at Orugal. Orugal, barely standing, was shaking his hand as if to apologize.
A moment of silence passed.
In the meantime, Jin asked all his colleagues except him and Kashimir to leave the place, and only Orugal and Zephyrin were left on the Kinzelo side.
"What were you thinking, Sir Orugal?"
[Keuk, keuk... cough]
"My master is in a difficult state to speak further, so I'll answer on his behalf, people of Zipel."
Zephyrin, carrying Orugal, spoke.
"First of all, Zipel side, please don't get excited and listen to my story. I understand you are irritated because Jin brought up sensitive content without thinking."
"Irritated? Do you think that's all?"
As Octavia interrupted, a glint of hostility flashed in Zephyrin's eyes.

"Please do not interrupt. This is not a request but a warning. My master knew of that place before you called it a sanctuary, and was once its administrator. Therefore, when the master lost his power, it came into your possession."
"So are you claiming ownership?"
Ronil's voice was calm again.
Whether it was due to Ronil's great composure, or not, Jin didn't think that was the whole story.
'It seems like they didn't come here without considering the sanctuary.'
Octavia and Kadun may not know, but Ronil seemed likely. Perhaps, the unpleasant expression might have been calculated as well.

"That's not it. After defeating the public enemy, if a moment comes when it can be taken back with power, we'll see. But for now, that place is clearly the property of Zipel. However, it's difficult to tolerate the attitude that there is no right to speak about what is known."
"What will you do if you can't tolerate it, Demon Dragon?"
"It seems that the successor of the Fire Dragon Trakalnis is curious about that, then please continue."
As soon as the name 'Trakalnis' came out, Kadun's eyes shook instantly.
"How do you know about Trakalnis...!"
"I remember because it was quite a satisfying meal."
The usual Kadun would have been furious at this point, ready to kill Zephyrin.
However, the Fire Dragon Trakalnis was the king of the previous Fire Dragons and the most perfect creation of Shinu.
Still, there is no history left in the world about Trakalnis, and even Kadun himself finds it hard to remember his name unless he usually focuses.
The reason is nothing else. Trakalnis's death was the greatest 'shame' of the Fire God Shinu and the Fire Dragons.
Erasing the history of Trakalnis was the will of Shinu and the old Zipel who wanted to cover up that shame.
'Is the one who killed Trakalnis... that demon dragon?'
Zephyrin smiled coldly as if she saw through Kadun's inner thoughts.
"You are probably thinking correctly, Kadun. If it is hard to believe, ask your god directly. I'm not sure if Shinu can restore that memory..."
Kadun avoided Zephyrin's gaze first.
It was not because the moment of Trakalnis's death came to mind, or some fearful memory came up. Somehow, an unbearable fear was slowly eroding Kadun's inner thoughts.
-I wouldn't have been too afraid even if I were dealing with you in your prime. The reason you don't know me well is simply because I couldn't fight you at that time.
Jin was recalling what she had said to Murakan the day Zephyrin's identity was first revealed in the past Black King Mountain.
'Did Kadun put his tail down so quickly...?'
Judging from the appearance of Orugal, who is carried like a sick patient, and the appearance of Zephyrin so far, it was hard to imagine their heyday.
However, it was clear that Kadun was crumpled even when speaking as if insulting Shinu.
The one most shocked by Kadun's reaction was Octavia. Since Kadun backed down, she could no longer show her anger at Zephyrin.
"It seems that Kadun's curiosity has been satisfied. Shall we get back to the main point?"
Zephyrin pointed at Jin with a gesture.
"...The atmosphere has deteriorated unnecessarily. First of all, I didn't bring up this story with this intention, so I'll pass on my apologies to both sides."
"Sir Jin is saving Zipel's face, it's an important issue."
"Wake up Orugal, Zephyrin, if you're going to keep nagging. We didn't gather to play mind games."
"That's why I don't like humans. Because their lives are short, they have no fear, anyway."
"Lord Ronil."
"Speak, Lord Jin."
"Hyster's survival is essential even for us to kill the public enemy. If it's hard to open the sanctum of Zipel, at least get the Tears of Numerus."
"I don't think we can say 'at least' the Tears of Numerus. And we also do not possess the Tears of Numerus. Let's take a look at Hyster first."
The act of showing unconscious Valeria to Zipel.
Jin felt guilty just doing that, but he had no choice to save her.
After all, her appearance was already exposed to Zipel, so there was no reason to hide it with effort.
The brains of Zipel who checked on Valeria in the ward each sighed or held their foreheads.
Even though they already knew the information, seeing it directly with their eyes was another matter.
"...I see why you mentioned tears first. The fatigue is indeed an incurable state. Were you maintaining the seal, Lord Jin?"
"That's impressive. You can count the people who can maintain such a seal in Zipel on one hand."
"What will you do? If the opening of the sanctum is impossible and there are no tears. Even though I exposed Hyster to Zipel just by that, it's a loss, but I'll let you figure it out on your own."
If they weren't going to open the sanctum, they should leave immediately.
"This is not a problem that we can decide from our line, Lord Jin."
"Both our side and Kinzel always have decision-makers who can make immediate decisions on the spot."
"We know. Right now... I'll go back and tell my father about this and get an answer."
"I'm looking forward to good news."
"Although everyone is trying to save Hyster for the temporary alliance as a whole, more precisely for each's own desire. Probably a fair compensation for this will be needed, Lord Jin."
The brains of Zipel returned to Tikan two days after that.
This time, Ronil came alone with a few practitioners without Kadun and Octavia.
"My father also said that there is no way but to open the sanctum. He said he would allow Hyster to be brought into the sanctum."
"What are the requirements?"

"First, only Hyster alone can enter the sanctum. Second, as a compensation for this matter, each alliance shares some of the content about chaos purification and control with Zipel. This must necessarily be accompanied by the admission of the Azmil contractor."
"I refuse."
Jin refused outright as if he didn't want to hear more.
"Well... then we cannot save Hyster."

"I heard from Orgal that when a complete mana entity goes to your sanctuary, some sort of mana trace remains. He also said that Zipel could get quite a lot of compensation just by researching that trace. It's unknown how fatal the damage to us will be after the future disbanding of the alliance."
Jin shrugged his shoulders.

"Who benefits the most from Hyster being hurt? It's Zipel. For us, it's all about saving Hyster, but Zipel can also do research. So I hope you won't be more greedy. If this breaks down, all talk about Hyster will be as if it never happened. That means don't play cheap."

"I understand. Then without any conditions, we will open the sanctuary, but to prevent exposing the location of the sanctuary, you must agree to move with as much sensation blocked as possible. Also, I would prefer no other escorts for Lord Jin and Hyster."
The requirements were just words Ronil had thrown out. It's what he got after hearing the opinions of the family elders.
Ronil hadn't liked their opinions.
"I understand that much. When would be a good time to leave?"
"If it's okay, let's go right away."
From the time Jin boarded the Cozec, he didn't move a step from the windowless cabin.
He just clung tightly to the sealed Valeria and quietly waited for the airship to stop.
It was five days later when the airship reached its destination.
"You've worked hard, Lord Jin. You may come out now."
As soon as Jin left the airship, he was able to recognize that this place was inside a massive structure.
It was even larger than the construction site he had seen in the Sota desert in the past.
Ronil's guidance took about two hours. When they reached a door inside the building, Ronil stopped.
"This is as far as I can guide you. I can't access beyond here either, someone else will assist you."
Only two people in Zipel had unrestricted access beyond the door.
One was the head of the family, Kelliac Zipel, and the second was.
"Are you Jin Runcandel?"
The heir, Veradin Zipel.
Veradin was walking towards Jin from the other side.
The friend from enemy territory whom he met after about 3 years didn't greet him cheerfully as always, instead, he spoke in a dry voice.
"Follow me, I will guide you to the sanctum."
Veradin, walking ahead beyond the door, looked incredibly unfamiliar.
At Veradin's waist, there was a sword.
